description: Source code for the Translation controller in the Opencart admin panel, managing translation listings, forms, and related actions.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: Controller class handling CRUD operations for translation entities, including listing, creating, editing, enabling/disabling, deleting, and retrieving translation data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that sets up the translation management interface, including breadcrumbs, filters, and data loading.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to retrieve the list of translations and outputs the translation list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Constructs and returns the translation list HTML with filters, pagination, and data.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a translation entry.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of new or edited translation entries via POST data.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Retrieves language file paths for a given language, including core and extension language files.

methods.name: translation
methods.description: Loads specific translation data for a store and language, returning translation keys and values.
